AppError.description: The app refused the call (`APP_ERROR`, one of its declared errors) or the run trapped (`TRAP`).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed (`BAD_REQUEST`), names a reserved method (`RESERVED_METHOD`), or carries an approval for another call (`WRONG_CHALLENGE`).

ConfirmRequired.description: `CONFIRM_REQUIRED`: approve the call with the passkey and send it again with `confirm`.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not call this method of this app (`FORBIDDEN`), or the app is read-only.

Gone.description: `UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE`: the app is an SDK 0.12 app, which this node no longer runs.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: a public method's rate, or the node's limits.

Unauthorized.description: No valid session or API key, and the method is not public.

Unavailable.description: `UNAVAILABLE` or `TIMEOUT`: retry with the same idempotency key.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry with the same key is answered once, from the first run.

events.description: The events the call emitted that the caller is in the audience of.

session.description: A passkey session's token or an API key, as `Authorization: Bearer`, inside the sealed channel.

info.description: Generated from the app's ABI (its `calimero:abi` section). Every request and answer travels inside the node's sealed channel, after the client has verified the node's attestation: use mero-js or calimero-client-py as the transport (the typed clients `meroctl app codegen` writes do), not plain HTTP. `POST /apps/{app}/methods/{name}` runs exactly as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` (a call) or `POST /apps/{app}/views` (a view) with the same `method`: the same authentication, gating, passkey step-up and limits. Errors are `{ error, message, details }`.
info.title: forum

get.description: Server-sent events: the committed events from log index `from`, then live ones. Each frame's `event` is the event's name, `id` is `<index>:<seq>` and `data` its fields as JSON. A subscriber receives only the events it is in the audience of.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "addModerator"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Appoints `account` a moderator. Moderators only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "announce"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Announces `text` under `id`. The caller's announcement at `id` is never edited:
announcing there again is `Exists`. Another account's announcement at `id` is a row
of its own.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "announcements"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Every announcement by id, one row per author holding the id.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "authorFeed"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Someone's posts across every board, newest first.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "boardFeed"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: One page of a board, newest first.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "boardSince"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A board's posts created after `after`, oldest first: what a client polls.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "boardStats"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A board's post and pin counts, from maintained counts.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "boardTagFeed"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
One page of a board's posts carrying `tag`, newest first: one range of the tag
index, so other boards' posts with the tag are never read.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "charter"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: What the forum was founded with. There is no setter.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "comment"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Comments on a post and returns the comment's key. `id` is the caller's to
choose: the key carries their account, so it only collides with their own.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "comments"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: One page of a post's thread, oldest first: one range of the thread index.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "createPost"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Files a post and returns its id, `"<caller>-<id>"`: `id` is the caller's to
choose and only ever collides with their own posts.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "deleteComment"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Takes the caller's comment at `key` back; anyone else's is `NoComment`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "deletePost"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Deletes the caller's post with its tags, votes and comments, so a post later filed at
the same id starts with none, and answers whether it is gone. One call removes at most
250 of those rows and the post only once none is left: `false` means rows remain, so
call again.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "editComment"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Replaces the caller's comment at `key`. Another account's comment is not the
caller's to address: `NoComment`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "editPost"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Replaces the title and body of the caller's post.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getPost"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: The post at `id`, or `null`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "me"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: The caller's own account, as the app sees it.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "messages"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A board's chat in `sentAt` order: one range of the `chat` index.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "moderatePost"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Removes the post at `id`, whoever wrote it, with its tags, votes and comments, and
answers whether it is gone. One call removes at most 250 of those rows and the post
only once none is left: `false` means rows remain, so call again. Moderators only.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "moderators"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Who may remove any post or announcement.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "pin"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Pins the caller's post to the top of its board, ordered by `at`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "pinned"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A board's pinned posts, most recently pinned first.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "postMessage"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Posts a message to a board's chat and returns its key, `"<board>/<id>"`. A message
is final: posting again where the caller wrote is `Exists`, and no method edits or
removes one. Another account's message at the key is a row of its own.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "removeAnnouncement"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Takes down every account's announcement at `id`. Moderators only, not even the
announcement's author. `false` if nobody holds `id`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "retag"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Replaces the tags of the caller's post: it leaves the old tags' feeds and joins
the new ones.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "unpin"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Unpins the caller's post.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "unvote"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Takes the caller's vote back (nobody else's) and returns the post's score.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "vote"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Upvotes a post and returns its score. Voting twice is one vote: the vote is the
row `(post, caller)`.

tags.description: Writes: each runs once, in order, through the app's log.

tags.description: Reads: answered from the app's state without writing.
tags.name: view

tags.description: The app's committed events, then live.
